summary: Give short identifiers a minimum display width.
documentation: padStart returns a string padded at its beginning until it reaches the requested length. The padding repeats and is truncated as needed. Strings already long enough are returned without shortening.
inputs: A target string length and optional padding text.
returns: A padded string, or the original text when no padding is needed.
caution: Padding formats display text; it does not validate identifiers. Empty padding cannot lengthen a string.
scenarios: Align numeric text in a plain-text report.
title: Format a pickup ticket
problem: Input is a string of decimal digits. Return it padded on the left with zeroes to at least five characters. Never shorten longer identifiers and do not convert the string to a number.
goal: Use String.padStart() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Choose target length 5 and padding text 0.
